notes: §1985:IX.2.3.2 prints the indexed entry SELECT [OPTIONAL], ASSIGN, [RESERVE], [ORGANIZATION IS] INDEXED, [ACCESS MODE], RECORD KEY IS data-name-1, [ALTERNATE RECORD KEY ... [WITH DUPLICATES]] ..., [FILE STATUS], in any order after SELECT (§1985:IX.2.3.3 SR1). Every clause foreign to it is refused at 85: RequiredClauses/Screen a missing ASSIGN or RECORD KEY (COBOL5701); ScreenClauseRepetition a second ORGANIZATION or FILE STATUS (COBOL2423); RESERVE 0 COBOL2386; prime key WITH DUPLICATES COBOL1970; OPTIONAL twice COBOL5506; RELATIVE KEY COBOL0863; LOCK MODE, SHARING, ASSIGN USING, COLLATING SEQUENCE, SOURCE keys, SUPPRESS WHEN COBOL0900; and, since kb/Work PB5565, PADDING CHARACTER and RECORD DELIMITER COBOL2912, both by the one EntryClauses table (PADDING CHARACTER is a Format 3 row, printed only in the sequential entry, §1985:VII.2.7.4 GR1; FileControlKeyRuleDriftTests.PaddingClause_IsCarriedBySequentialFormatAlone re-derives it from the 1985 and 2002 diagrams). The full format writes and reads. History: this row read PARTIAL naming kb/Work PB5565, which fixed it.
